text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock B for gains felt satisfying, but I should not sell just to lock in a win; I should weigh each holding’s prospects and risks.","My average cost and reluctance to admit a mistake should not decide whether I hold or sell; I should judge each stock on what I know now.","I rarely trade, and that can help me avoid impulsive decisions, but I should still review my portfolio regularly and act when the evidence warrants it."]}
